reason: The indexed primitive cell, Z=1, and Li2FeSiO4-derived tetrahedral framework are credible and chemically plausible, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the reported profile refinement used a custom restricted-range model rather than a documented comparable score. More importantly, the submitted P1 coordinates came from one arbitrarily selected Li-vacancy derivative: all four vacancy choices were instantiated only at the unrefined parent-coordinate stage, their RMS values were essentially tied (1.0979-1.1022), and the selected removal was not the lowest-RMS case. Those alternatives were not independently coordinate-refined or submitted, and materially different symmetry/ordering realizations were not compared. Thus the data support the cell and average framework much more strongly than the exact symmetry, coordinates, and Li-vacancy ordering, so another solution attempt is warranted.
